target_subject: a single person depicted in profile

scene: A dark blue background with a large white circular shape behind the person's head.
Stylized turquoise and white wavy lines resembling water occupy the lower half of the image.
Small white starburst-like shapes appear near the left and right edges of the water area.
action: The person is shown in static profile, facing left, with eyes open and gaze directed forward.
A textured blue mass occupies the upper portion of the skull, extending downward past the earlobe.
A small white object with a thin line connects to the person’s neck near the clavicle region.
rationale: The white circle behind the head may function as a halo or spotlight due to its centered placement and contrast; however, no religious iconography is present to confirm this.
The blue mass inside the head resembles brain tissue in shape but is rendered with granular texture and color not anatomically accurate; thus its nature is symbolic or stylized.
The wave forms are clearly delineated with black outlines and alternating turquoise/white bands, indicating intentional graphic design rather than photographic realism.
object: The person has brown skin, a shaved head, defined eyebrows, a straight nose, closed lips, and visible earlobes.
A blue textured form fills the cranial cavity from the frontal lobe region backward and drips down along the temporal side, ending below the ear.
A small white irregularly shaped object with a thin curved line attaches near the base of the neck on the right side (viewer’s left).
The water-like pattern consists of layered undulating bands: outer white crests, inner turquoise troughs, and black contour lines separating them.
Two small white starburst figures with radiating lines are positioned at the left and right margins of the wave zone, partially overlapping the waves.

symbolic_mapping: blue mass → internal cognition or mental content
waves → external environment or emotional flux

alternative_interpretations: It may represent a literal depiction of neurological fluid leakage or medical imaging artifact, rendered artistically.
limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm the intended symbolism of the blue mass or waves.

alternative_interpretations: The neck object could be jewelry or a decorative element with no functional implication.
limitations: The object’s form is ambiguous; it lacks identifiable features of known devices or ornaments.

starbursts → moments of insight or disruption
